info.name: VideoGame Platform Backend - Game Details
info.description: Executable UC-003 examples for the existing reviewed OpenAPI contract. Use the disposable development seed before any rating contributions are inserted. No provider credentials or calls are needed.

item.name: Public released game and empty aggregate

exec: pm.test("Empty aggregate is not unavailable or a numeric mean", () => { pm.expect(game.ratingStatistics.status).to.eql("available"); pm.expect(game.ratingStatistics.count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(game.ratingStatistics.mean).to.eql(null); pm.expect(Object.keys(game.ratingStatistics.distribution)).to.have.lengthOf(10); Object.values(game.ratingStatistics.distribution).forEach(n => pm.expect(n).to.eql(0)); });

pm.test("Application-derived date and public headers", () => { pm.expect(game.ratingEligibility.evaluatedOn).to.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control")).to.eql("public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Correlation-ID")).not.to.be.empty; });

pm.test("Product release stages", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); const releases = body.releases || (body.items || []).flatMap(item => item.releases || []); releases.forEach(r => pm.expect(["full_release", "early_access", "advance_access", "beta", "alpha", "unknown"]).to.include(r.stage)); });

item.name: Several records for one platform in presentation order

exec: pm.test("Every stored record is returned unmerged", () => { pm.expect(releases).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(new Set(releases.map(r => r.region.regionId)).size).to.eql(2); });

pm.test("Releases are listed platform by platform", () => { const platforms = releases.map(r => r.platform.platformId); platforms.forEach((platform, index) => { if (index > 0 && platform !== platforms[index - 1]) pm.expect(platforms.slice(index)).not.to.include(platforms[index - 1]); }); });
pm.test("The presented record leads its platform", () => pm.expect(releases[0].region.name).to.eql("Europe"));

item.description: Metroid Prime 4 has two same-day Nintendo Switch 2 records in Europe and Japan. Both are returned; each platform's records are contiguous and its presented record comes first, here Europe by the stable region order.

exec: pm.test("Unknown precision remains explicit", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().releases.some(r => r.releaseDate.precision === "unknown" && r.releaseDate.value === null)).to.eql(true));

pm.test("Stable correlated Problem", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.code).to.eql("GAME_NOT_FOUND"); pm.expect(body.correlationId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get("X-Correlation-ID")); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control")).to.eql("no-store"); });

pm.test("Stable correlated Problem", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.code).to.eql("REQUEST_PARAMETER_UNKNOWN"); pm.expect(body.correlationId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get("X-Correlation-ID")); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control")).to.eql("no-store"); });
